program.degree_note: The university degree is awarded by NIAT's collaborating university, not by NxtWave. NIAT provides the industry-oriented upskilling layer on top of the degree curriculum.
program.placement_note: NIAT provides placement support and access to NxtWave's hiring ecosystem. Outcomes depend on student performance and market conditions. Placement is not guaranteed.
program.nat_note: NAT (NxtWave Aptitude Test) is an independent assessment. It is not a university entrance exam.

objection_responses.fees: NIAT offers EMI options and scholarship support. A counselor can walk through the exact fee structure for your preferred campus.
objection_responses.placement_anxiety: NIAT provides structured placement support and access to NxtWave's hiring network. Results depend on the student's performance and market conditions. We do not guarantee placements.
objection_responses.is_niat_a_real_college: NIAT is an upskilling program layered on top of a university degree. Your child earns a recognized degree from the collaborating university, plus NIAT's industry certifications.
objection_responses.campus_location: NIAT has campuses across South India. A counselor can help match the right campus to your city and hostel needs.
objection_responses.hostel_safety: NIAT campuses have dedicated hostel facilities with security. A counselor can share campus-specific hostel details.
objection_responses.academic_pressure: NIAT combines standard university academics with practical industry projects. The curriculum is designed to be challenging but supported.
objection_responses.comparison_btech: Unlike a conventional B.Tech, NIAT adds live industry projects, mentorship, and placement support on top of the same university degree.
objection_responses.timing_payment: Enrollment timelines and payment schedules can be discussed with a counselor. EMI options are available.
objection_responses.trust_credibility: NxtWave has trained a large number of students. NIAT is its residential, degree-integrated program. A counselor can share student testimonials and alumni outcomes.
